---
title: "LMS on Start and Void"
description: "Verify the sealed LMS Worker, its area bindings, and the canonical gateway cutover."
---

## Qualification

`lms-cloudflare.yaml` emits the route-free `tuturuuu-lms` Worker with Void on
Vite+. The artifact includes the exact source SHA and per-file hashes in
`lms-native-artifact.json`, plus `lms-native-artifact.sha256` for the receipt
and archive. The archive disables public previews and has no routes or schedules.
The workflow does not upload a Worker or change traffic.

The Worker receives the original apex request through `MOUNT_LMS`. The
`TEACH` and `LEARN` service bindings carry that request unchanged to
`tuturuuu-teach` and `tuturuuu-learn`. Those builds must independently pass
their emitted-Worker tests for the nested area mounts. Service binding mocks
in the LMS Workerd suite prove the dispatch boundary. They do not replace
acceptance with the actual bound versions. Each dispatch chooses one service
and makes one call, with no retry or background work. Clearing the LMS gateway
paths stops ingress to the deployment.

## Request latency

The LMS shell renders on the compiled `/lms` router base and serves immutable,
fingerprinted assets. Learn renders its menu from workspace bootstrap data.
An LMS bootstrap request with a verified Learn bearer skips a second provider
refresh in the proxy. The bootstrap handler retains its existing authorization,
suspension and rate controls. Signed-in hosted measurements are required
before enabling permanent redirects.

## Gateway handoff

1. Record the pinned LMS, Teach, Learn and gateway version IDs, exact commit
   hashes, DNS and route definitions, mounted paths, and service bindings.
   Check that the LMS archive digest and both area build identities match the
   reviewed source.
2. Bind `MOUNT_LMS` and add `/lms,/lms/*` to `GATEWAY_MOUNTED_PATHS`. Keep the
   existing Teach mount, legacy domains, and old Learn route available during
   acceptance. The gateway owner enables the canonical landing's indexing
   through `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=0` after staging acceptance.
3. Verify HTTPS `/lms`, `/lms/api/build-info`, and both area build-info paths.
   Load all emitted assets, including fonts, in English and Vietnamese. Check
   that fingerprinted assets cache and private responses do not. Compare cold
   and warm header latency on the landing, learner dashboard, and static assets.
4. Using the approved fleet identity, follow Web login back to a nested lesson.
   Confirm one shared session when switching areas. Open the teacher dashboard,
   edit and revert a disposable course module and quiz, enter and revert
   attendance, and verify gradebook and report access. In Learn, open a course,
   resume a practice activity, verify progress, and test an approved parent
   invitation fixture without logging its token. Repeat with a learner-only
   and a dual-role account. An unauthorized workspace or role must never load
   protected content.
5. Only after those checks pass, enable `GATEWAY_LMS_REDIRECTS=1` and route
   legacy document requests at the edge to the gateway. Preserve existing
   machine traffic on the legacy origins during transition. Verify HTTP 301
   from all three subdomains and the two apex mounts, with encoded nested
   paths and repeated queries. Verify the canonical route does not loop.

## Rollback

Restore the captured serving gateway configuration in one operation and
restore the captured legacy host routes if they changed. Clearing the redirect
flag stops new redirects. Keep the canonical mount available to browsers that
already followed permanent redirects when possible. Validate the restored Teach
mount and Learn subdomain with a signed-in smoke. Data remains in the shared
education store through either routing configuration.

See [LMS product behavior](/platform/applications/lms), [Teach qualification](/build/devops/teach-start-void),
and [Learn qualification](/build/devops/learn-start-void).
